review_evidence: README describes Comparator as a trustworthy judge that checks submitted Lean solutions against challenge statements, permitted axioms, kernel acceptance, and optional nanoda rechecking.

A complete proposition-file scan found theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations only under tests/projects/* Challenge.lean and Solution.lean fixtures; production Comparator/*.lean contains the export comparison, axiom checking, state, and process implementation.

The challenge/solution propositions are deliberately tiny cases for mismatch, axiom, primitive, quotient, projection, and definition-hole behavior rather than an independent mathematical development or proof of Comparator itself.
